title: Secure Info-Gathering on Autopilot
desc: Your current way of gathering info from customers could be time consuming, antiquated and unsecured. This results in long deal times, bad customer experiences, and potential steep compliance penalties. SalesAssist automates the way your dealership gathers info from customers, directly from your CRM.

reasons.title: Benefits Dealership
reasons.desc: Eliminate compliance liability; Shorten the sales process; Boost conversion rate.

reasons.title: Benefits Salespeople
reasons.desc: Free up your salespeople to do more value-added work; Eliminate data entry errors.

reasons.title: Benefits Customers
reasons.desc: Improve your customer's experience by streamlining the sales process.
